citation.fr: [{\"type\": \"dataset\", \"id\": \"ca.cioos_4be3cc15-e836-45a7-9357-14275e516018\", \"author\": [{\"given\": \"Joanne\", \"family\": \"Lessard\"}, {\"given\": \"Kayleigh\", \"family\": \"Gillespie\"}], \"issued\": [{\"date-parts\": [\"2025\", \"03\", \"26\"]}], \"abstract\": \"P\u00eaches et Oc\u00e9ans (MPO), en collaboration avec des partenaires de recherche, a install\u00e9 des capteurs de conductivit\u00e9 et de temp\u00e9rature dans la r\u00e9gion c\u00f4ti\u00e8re du Pacifique. Il y a 4 capteurs sur la c\u00f4te nord et 9 dans la r\u00e9gion de la c\u00f4te sud\u00a0: 4 sur la c\u00f4te ouest de l'\u00eele de Vancouver (WCVI) et 5 dans la moiti\u00e9 nord de l'\u00eele de Vancouver. D'autres capteurs devraient \u00eatre install\u00e9s et inclus dans cet ensemble de donn\u00e9es, et les futurs capteurs auront une profondeur en plus des autres variables mesur\u00e9es.\", \"edition\": \"\", \"edition-date\": \"\", \"publisher\": \"\", \"title\": \"Donn\u00e9es de P\u00eaches et Oc\u00e9ans Canada des capteurs de la surface de la mer littorale pour la conductivit\u00e9, la temp\u00e9rature et la profondeur dans la r\u00e9gion du Pacifique\", \"language\": \"fr\", \"URL\": \"http://localhost:5000/dataset/ca-cioos_4be3cc15-e836-45a7-9357-14275e516018?local=fr\"}]
citation.en: [{\"type\": \"dataset\", \"id\": \"ca.cioos_4be3cc15-e836-45a7-9357-14275e516018\", \"author\": [{\"given\": \"Joanne\", \"family\": \"Lessard\"}, {\"given\": \"Kayleigh\", \"family\": \"Gillespie\"}], \"issued\": [{\"date-parts\": [\"2025\", \"03\", \"26\"]}], \"abstract\": \"Fisheries and Oceans (DFO) in collaboration with research partners installed conductivity and temperature sensors in the Pacific coastal region. There are 4 sensors in the north coast, and 9 in the south coast region - 4 on the west coast of Vancouver Island (WCVI), and 5 in the northern half of Vancouver Island. Additional sensors are planned to be installed and included in this dataset, and future sensors will have depth in addition to the other variables measured.\", \"edition\": \"\", \"edition-date\": \"\", \"publisher\": \"\", \"title\": \"Fisheries and Oceans Canada Nearshore Sea Surface Sensor Data for Conductivity, Temperature, and Depth in the Pacific Region\", \"language\": \"en\", \"URL\": \"http://localhost:5000/dataset/ca-cioos_4be3cc15-e836-45a7-9357-14275e516018?local=en\"}]
